transformations: Analysis rows retain only identities, labels, numeric grades and validation flags; raw model text is omitted.
CE scores and all stored metric rows are copied byte-for-byte.
Candidate text is replaced by SHA-256 hashes; exact request bodies are hashed using UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and ensure_ascii=False.
The request template retains exact common system instructions, serialization adapter and schema; topic entries and paper text are placeholders.
Pool configuration omits the private spending ceiling; public protocol omits the private spending-authorization sentence.
No abstracts, patient data, provider credentials, pilot materials or model API runners are included.
